scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefits_summary: Non-contributory monthly pension for Below Poverty Line (BPL) senior citizens (₹200 central share + state top-up ranging from ₹600 to ₹2,500 per month).
application_steps: Submit the IGNOAPS application at your Gram Panchayat (rural) or Municipal Office (urban) or State Seva Sindhu/CSC portal.
Undergo verification by the Block Development Officer or Tehsildar.
Receive monthly pension directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
